_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); net revenue, credit cost, expense, nonperforming-asset and pre-tax margin signals with JPMorgan Chase's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'JPMorgan Chase & Co. ... is a leading global financial services firm and one of the largest banking institutions in the United States' 'JPMorgan Chase’s businesses are materially affected by economic and market conditions' 'The financial services industry is highly competitive, and JPMorgan Chase’s inability to compete successfully may adversely affect its results of operations.' (FY2011 10-K); DURABLE, risk 2: the 10-K ties results to markets and the economy, a cycle and a competitive field, and does not call its own business cyclical (the word does not appear in it: the LOW and SHW reading); no theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a bank holding company on these dates (OFFSHORE is scoped to IT services), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

(FY2011 10-K); DURABLE, risk 2: the 10-K ties results to markets and the economy, a cycle and a competitive field, and does not call its own business cyclical (the word does not appear in it: the LOW and SHW reading); no theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a bank holding company on these dates (OFFSHORE is scoped to IT services), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.75x; -8% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.67; conservative 2yr +39%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -80.1%/yr (worst year FY03-FY11, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -25.0%/yr (Q2 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 9.6-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +4.4%/yr (FY03-FY11 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +112.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY11, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: JPM (retrospective, 2012-08-24) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.75x (96.0% downside to Bear $1.49 / +128.4% upside to Bull $84.91) | Adj composite 2.50 vs market 1.83: gap +0.67 [UNDERVALUED] | -8% above the EPP floor $40.32 (9x FY12E $4.48) | Conservative 2-yr case: +39.2% total (+19.6%/yr) | At 8.3x FY12E the 15% hurdle price $49.16 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; revenue -17.2% YoY in Q2 2012, forward revenues -17.2% (Q2 2012 revenue growth (no Q3 2012 guide)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
